from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class HousingStartRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single housing start data point extracted from one report."""
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="Release date of the report (YYYY-MM)")
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="Month the data represents (YYYY-MM)")
    category: Literal["single-family", "buildings with two to four units", "buildings with five or more units"] = Field(description="Housing unit category")
    value: float | None = Field(description="Not seasonally adjusted housing starts (in thousands)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_start_records: list[HousingStartRecord]
